run_cheetah_environment: run the cheetah DMC environment with a configurable time limit and optional noisy sensors
get_model_and_assets: get the cheetah MuJoCo model XML string and asset dictionary for the physics simulation
Physics_speed: get the horizontal running speed of the cheetah from the physics sensor data with optional noise
Cheetah_get_observation: get an observation dict with position and velocity from the cheetah physics state
Cheetah_get_reward: get a linear tolerance reward based on the cheetah running speed relative to the target speed
